environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB is internet-facing with no listener rules restricting source IP. Security groups on the ECS tasks allow inbound from the ALB security group on port 80. No authentication middleware is applied to the /documents/{id}/debug route. APP_DEBUG=true in production .env, exposing full stack traces including memory addresses and internal paths on error.
